note: USFS Custer Gallatin NF campground (Hebgen Lake RD) among lodgepole pines on the South Fork arm of Hebgen Lake, ~20 min W of West Yellowstone (8 mi W on US 20, then 4 mi N on Denny Creek Rd). --Claude
summary: Concessionaire-run (ExplorUS) Forest Service campground, reservable on recreation.gov. Confirmed 26 sites, 45-ft spurs, 50-amp electric with no water/sewer, vault toilets, drinking water, $26/$35 peak rates (fees left as recorded); added no showers/no dump, season 5/15-9/27 (was only 'not year-round'), 16-night limit. Not stated: fcfs. The Lonesomewood prescribed-fire closure is north of Hebgen Lake, not here. Note trimmed of restated values and the 'mid-Sep' close the page contradicts.
flags: Missing phone: recreation.gov gives 406-646-1012 for the campground (https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233331); the Forest Service page lists none.
